name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Acoustic Denial System ADS-9 'Hush'
description: A tripod-mounted acoustic weapon that projects a precisely calibrated anti-sound field, generating destructive interference patterns that cancel all sound within a targeted 20-meter zone. Within the zone, speech is impossible, radio communication is disrupted by the acoustic interference, gunshots produce no audible report, and alarms cannot be heard. The ADS-9 effectively creates a bubble of absolute silence — a disorienting, unnatural environment where the absence of sound is itself a weapon. Human targets within the zone report intense psychological distress, loss of spatial awareness, and difficulty maintaining balance without acoustic feedback.
specifications: effect radius: 20-meter targeted zone frequency cancellation: 20 Hz to 20 kHz — full human audible range setup time: 45 seconds power source: Vehicle feed or portable generator weight: 28 kg on tripod effect on electronics: Disrupts microphone-based systems within zone psychological effect: Disorientation, balance disruption, anxiety maximum deployment time: 30 minutes before emitter overheating
story_hooks: A bank robbery was executed inside an ADS-9 silence field — alarms did not sound, victims could not call for help, and security footage shows mouths opening in screams that produced no sound.
An ADS-9 has been permanently installed in a Tier 3 building's basement, creating a zone where no conversation can be recorded or overheard — it has become the most secure meeting space in GLMZ.
related_entities: Axiom Systems White Noise Bubble Generator WNB-1

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist tripod-mounted emitter system resembling an inverted satellite dish mounted on reinforced steel legs. The device presents as militaristic and imposing — a technological instrument of control rather than conventional violence. Its presence suggests capabilities beyond the kinetic.
physical_description.dimensions: Height: 145 cm (tripod extended), Dish diameter: 68 cm, Base footprint: 120 × 120 cm when deployed
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial and deliberately heavy — 28 kg distributed across the tripod gives it stolid stability. Requires two-person setup but designed for tactical portability
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed titanium-composite dish, hardened steel tripod frame, reinforced polymer junction points
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with industrial weathering; the dish surface shows light oxidation patterns consistent with acoustic testing wear
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary, with dark steel tripod legs and burgundy accent striping on adjustment joints
physical_description.grip_texture: Rubberized grip sleeves on tripod adjustment handles; bare titanium-composite on the dish rim where technicians stabilize during deployment
distinctive_features: Recessed circular frequency-tuning array embedded in dish center — concentric rings of micro-transducers visible as faint geometric patterns
Three amber LED status indicators along the rear mount (power, calibration, active)
Hairline vents cut radially into the dish underside for thermal dissipation
Articulated magnetic coupling points for generator umbilical attachment
Precision gimbaled mount allowing 45-degree tilt in all axes
Serial plate mounted on tripod junction etched with ZHENG-DAO cipher and manufacturing date stamps
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES logo (stylized gear-and-wave motif) stamped on forward tripod leg; ADS-9 'HUSH' designation in Mandarin and Latin script on rear coupling bracket; serial number and GLMZ military authorization code engraved on the frequency regulator housing
physical_description.condition_typical: Military-maintained units show minimal cosmetic wear but evidence of field calibration — micro-scratches around adjustment points, slight discoloration from repeated thermal cycling, lint accumulation in frequency vents suggesting deployment in urban environments
